mentions.name: Browser-based Shenmue MMO experience
mentions.description: A browser-based MMO experience for the 1999 Dreamcast game Shenmue, playable on the web. It is still rough around the edges but has been well received by fans of the original game.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making a browser-based MMO experience of sorts for the 1999 Dreamcast game Shenmue - it's still pretty rough around the edges but people who like the game have liked it so far:

https://www.newyokosuka.com/
